data.answer: Restores are tested every quarter, with the most recent test conducted on 12 September 2026. The test was completed in 2 hours 40 minutes, which was within the 4-hour RTO, and the results were reviewed by the Engineering Manager and filed in the evidence folder.

Nimbus Labs uses 9 sub-processors that may process customer data, including AWS and an email delivery provider. The current list is shared with customers on request, and customers receive 30 days' advance notice before a new sub-processor is added, during which they may object in writing.
Tier 1 vendors are reviewed once a year and Tier 2 vendors are reviewed every two years. Additionally, any vendor that suffers a security incident is reviewed immediately.
A background check covering identity, employment history, and education is completed before the start date for every employee, intern, and contractor.

The manager notifies HR on or before the last working day, and all access is revoked within 4 hours of the person's exit time. Shared secrets are rotated within 2 business days, and company laptops are returned and wiped within 3 business days. The offboarding is recorded in the audit log and checked in the next quarterly access review.

Customer data is stored in India by default in AWS Mumbai, but disaster recovery copies are held in Singapore. Customers who need all copies of their data kept in India should discuss this with Nimbus Labs before signing.

Affected customers are notified within 72 hours when a breach involving customer data is confirmed. Nimbus Labs also reports to CERT-In within 6 hours of becoming aware of a reportable cyber incident as required by Indian rules, though the provided text does not specify a notification commitment for a suspected but not yet confirmed incident.
Support hours and the formal SLA are set in the contract.
